description: Outgoing and incoming wires for consumer, commercial, and correspondent clients through Federal Reserve payment services (about 11,000 outgoing wires a day, about $36 billion)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Same-day settlement deadlines of Federal Reserve payment services; commercial clients' payroll, tax, and real estate closings; liquidity of the bank and its clients. Accepted payment messages cannot be lost, so RPO is zero (journaled in both data centers before acknowledgment)
manual_workaround: Contingent sending through the Federal Reserve's offline contingency service for high-value wires; alternate wire operations room in Georgia; manual queue with dual control
dependent_systems: SYS-03; SYS-01; SYS-05; SYS-11 (sanctions and fraud screening); SYS-07
dependent_third_parties: Federal Reserve payment services; payments software vendor; network carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Wire operations room (Florida) and alternate room (Georgia); callback team
quantified_impact_basis: Wire fees (about $0.5 million a day), interest claims and compensation for late client payments (about $3.5 million a day at current rates), overtime, and an estimate of commercial client attrition
acquired_bank_dependency: Acquired bank clients send wires through SYS-03 since 2026-05-16 conversion; about 2,900 still initiate through the legacy portal (BP-20)
single_points_of_failure: Federal Reserve payment services (industry-wide); single payments hub instance (active in DC-1, standby in DC-2)

description: Originate and receive ACH entries for payroll, bill pay, and collections (about 3.2 million originated entries a day)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Settlement windows; payroll files must settle on the effective date; returns deadlines
manual_workaround: Reprocess files from the treasury platform's retained originals; extend processing windows; contact major originators
dependent_third_parties: Federal Reserve payment services; treasury management platform vendor
quantified_impact_basis: Late payroll and collections for commercial clients, compensation claims, fees, and overtime
acquired_bank_dependency: Acquired bank originators on the legacy portal

description: Real-time payments sent and received through Federal Reserve payment services and a bank-led person-to-person network
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customer expectation of real-time availability; irrevocable payments need fraud checks
manual_workaround: Direct customers to ACH or wires; suspend send with notice in the app
dependent_third_parties: Federal Reserve payment services; person-to-person network operator
quantified_impact_basis: Lost fees and customer service costs; reputation

business_process: Deposit account servicing and core posting
description: Real-time posting, balances, holds, and nightly batch for about 3.9 million deposit accounts on the core
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Balances drive every channel; nightly batch must finish before branches and digital channels open; a long outage can become a 12 CFR 53.3 notification incident
manual_workaround: Stand-in balance files for branches and card authorization; delay non-urgent maintenance; memo-post and reconcile after recovery
dependent_third_parties: Core software vendor; mainframe hardware vendor
quantified_impact_basis: About 45% of daily revenue at risk from halted servicing and deposit flows, plus fee waivers and overtime
acquired_bank_dependency: Acquired bank accounts converted to the core on 2026-05-16
single_points_of_failure: Single core instance (active in DC-1, recovery in DC-2); no isolated cyber vault copy (DEP-25)

business_process: Consumer and small business digital banking
description: Online and mobile banking for about 2.4 million consumer and 180,000 business users, including wire, ACH, and person-to-person payment initiation
process_owner: Head of Consumer and Small Business Banking
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customer access to money; call volumes triple within 2 hours of an outage; public outage reports
manual_workaround: Branches and contact centers; balance and transfer by phone with enhanced authentication
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; SMS and push notification service
quantified_impact_basis: Contact center surge and overtime, fee waivers, lost person-to-person and card revenue, and customer attrition estimate
single_points_of_failure: CIAM service (single tenant, second region standby)

description: Teller and platform services at 610 branches in six states
process_owner: Head of Consumer and Small Business Banking
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customer cash access; branch network is the fallback for digital outages
manual_workaround: Teller offline mode (store and forward, limits apply); cash withdrawals within offline limits; manual receipts
quantified_impact_basis: Lost fees and deposits, overtime, and reconciliation of offline transactions
acquired_bank_dependency: Acquired bank branches converted with the core
single_points_of_failure: SD-WAN hub in DC-1 (alternate hub in DC-2)

description: Real-time authorization of about 3.1 million debit cards and the credit card portfolio
process_owner: Head of Consumer and Small Business Banking
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Authorizations are real time; card processor stand-in covers core outages but not processor outages
manual_workaround: Card processor stand-in authorization with preset limits when the core is unavailable
quantified_impact_basis: Interchange (about $1.2 million a business day) and customer impact at point of sale
single_points_of_failure: Card processor (single processor for debit and credit)

description: About 1,480 ATMs in six states
process_owner: Head of Consumer and Small Business Banking
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash access; other networks' ATMs are available
manual_workaround: Direct customers to branches and network ATMs; waive surcharges
quantified_impact_basis: Surcharge waivers and lost fees

description: Commercial online banking, wire and ACH initiation, positive pay, host-to-host and API channels for about 41,000 commercial clients
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Commercial clients' same-day payments and fraud decisions (positive pay); SOC 2 Availability commitments to SL-1 clients (P09)
manual_workaround: Phone and secure file delivery of payment instructions with callback verification by the callback team; dual control on manual wires
dependent_third_parties: Treasury management platform vendor; Cloud provider A (API gateway)
quantified_impact_basis: Treasury fees and commercial deposit spread (about $1.6 million a business day), client payment penalties, and attrition estimate
acquired_bank_dependency: About 2,900 acquired bank clients remain on the legacy platform (BP-20)
single_points_of_failure: Treasury management platform vendor (contract RTO 4 h against a 2 h BIA RTO)

description: Consumer, business, and commercial contact centers (about 2.2 million calls a month) with caller authentication
process_owner: Head of Consumer and Small Business Banking
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contact centers absorb digital and branch outages; caller authentication protects against account takeover
manual_workaround: Route calls to other sites; callback queue; recorded outage message
dependent_systems: Cloud contact center service; SYS-01; SYS-05
dependent_third_parties: Contact center software vendor; telephony carriers
quantified_impact_basis: Abandoned calls, overtime, and complaints
single_points_of_failure: Cloud contact center service (backup carrier only)

business_process: Sanctions screening and payment fraud detection
description: Sanctions screening of every wire and instant payment, and fraud scoring of payments and logins
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No wire may be released without sanctions screening; fraud scoring protects against account takeover and BEC
manual_workaround: Manual sanctions review of queued payments by the financial crimes team (limited capacity); hold high-risk payments
dependent_third_parties: Sanctions screening software vendor; fraud scoring vendor; Cloud provider A
quantified_impact_basis: Wire and instant payment delays (see BP-01), manual review overtime, and fraud losses if scoring is bypassed
single_points_of_failure: Sanctions screening engine (active in DC-1, standby in DC-2)

business_process: Consumer lending origination (personal loans, credit cards, mortgage)
description: Digital and branch applications, credit decisioning (AI-001 for personal loans and cards), and adverse action notices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Applications can queue; adverse action notice timing (12 CFR 1002.9) continues
manual_workaround: Queue applications; manual underwriting for priority applications
dependent_systems: SYS-09; SYS-06 (credit decisioning on Cloud B); SYS-01
dependent_third_parties: Loan origination SaaS vendor; consumer reporting agencies; Cloud provider B
quantified_impact_basis: Delayed originations and lost applications
single_points_of_failure: Credit decisioning service (single region with backup restore)

description: Commercial loan origination, draws, payments, and servicing
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Draws and payoffs can be handled manually for a short time
manual_workaround: Manual draws with dual approval; queue servicing
quantified_impact_basis: Delayed draws and fees
acquired_bank_dependency: Acquired bank commercial loans converted with the core

description: Transaction monitoring, case management, and SAR filing (30-day SAR deadline under 12 CFR 21.11(d))
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Alerts can queue briefly, but the SAR deadline runs from initial detection
manual_workaround: Queue alerts; prioritize by risk; manual review of large wires
quantified_impact_basis: Overtime to clear backlogs; regulatory exposure if SAR deadlines slip

business_process: Treasury, liquidity, and Federal Reserve account management
description: Intraday liquidity, reserve account monitoring, funding, and collateral
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: End-of-day reserve account position and payment system obligations
manual_workaround: Manual position from Federal Reserve account statements; phone funding with counterparties
quantified_impact_basis: Overdraft charges, higher funding costs, and missed investment windows

business_process: Financial close, regulatory and SEC reporting
description: Close, Call Reports, FR Y-9C, 10-Q and 10-K
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Filing deadlines; the MTD drops to 48 h in the quarter-end window
manual_workaround: Restore from last close; extend close calendar
quantified_impact_basis: Overtime and advisers; filing risk at quarter-end

description: Order entry, account servicing, and advisory services for about 210,000 accounts through the clearing firm
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Trading-day obligations; the clearing firm executes and holds customer assets
manual_workaround: Orders by phone to the clearing firm's trade desk; client letters
quantified_impact_basis: Broker-dealer revenue (about $0.9 million a business day)

business_process: Institutional trust, custody, and retirement plan services (SL-2)
description: Trust accounting, custody, and retirement plan recordkeeping for institutional clients and plan participants
process_owner: Head of Wealth and Institutional Services
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Daily valuation and trade settlement; SOC 1 and planned SOC 2 commitments to SL-2 clients (P09)
manual_workaround: Manual trade instructions to the sub-custodian; delay participant transactions with notice
dependent_systems: Trust accounting and custody platform; SYS-05; SYS-06
quantified_impact_basis: Fees, client claims, and client attrition estimate

description: Payroll for 12,000 employees and HR case management
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll dates; state wage payment laws
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll with adjustments
quantified_impact_basis: Adjustment runs and overtime

business_process: Legacy commercial online banking for acquired bank clients
description: Wire and ACH initiation and balance reporting for about 2,900 business clients of the acquired bank until migration (due 2027-02-26)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Clients' same-day payments; the platform's contract RTO is 24 h
manual_workaround: Phone and secure file instructions with callback verification; accelerate migration of affected clients
dependent_systems: Legacy commercial online banking platform; SYS-03; SYS-01
dependent_people_or_facilities: Treasury management support; Integration Management Office
quantified_impact_basis: Fees and client payment penalties for about 2,900 clients
single_points_of_failure: Legacy platform vendor (contract RTO 24 h against an 8 h BIA RTO)

description: Campaigns, offers, and customer analytics on the enterprise data platform
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No customer service depends on it
